description: This file contains helper classes for representing, manipulating, and writing OpenSSL configuration files, including classes for properties, sections, and overall configuration.

classes.name: Property
classes.description: Represents a key/value pair in OpenSSL .cnf files.

classes.name: Section
classes.description: Represents a section in OpenSSL configuration files, containing properties.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Represents an entire OpenSSL configuration file composed of sections.

methods.name: write_to
methods.description: Outputs the property, section, or configuration to a file or output stream.

methods.name: set_property
methods.description: Replaces, adds, or removes a property within a section.

methods.name: add_property
methods.description: Adds a new property to a section.

methods.name: remove_property
methods.description: Removes a property from a section.

methods.name: clear_properties
methods.description: Removes all properties from a section.

methods.name: get_section
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a section by name.

methods.name: write_to_file
methods.description: Writes the entire configuration to a specified file.
